name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free bundle of ready-made instruction files that make AI coding assistants like Claude Code work the way an experienced engineer would, instead of guessing.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small dev shop who wants every developer's AI assistant to follow the same disciplined process (asking clarifying questions, writing docs, filing tickets) without writing that playbook themselves.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs the skill pack so client work goes through a consistent 'grill the client on requirements' step before any code is written, cutting rework.
An engineering lead standardizes onboarding: every new hire's AI agent runs the same skills, so AI-assisted output looks consistent across the team.
A solo founder uses the shared-language ('CONTEXT.md') skill to keep their AI agent from re-learning project jargon every session, saving prompting time.

money_ideas.idea: Run paid workshops or a course teaching teams how to adopt and customize this exact skill workflow for their own codebase.
Offer a premium, actively-maintained fork with extra skills (e.g. industry-specific playbooks) behind a subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, package one of these skills (like the 'grill-me' requirements-gathering flow) into a Notion or Gumroad template sold to freelancers who want to look more professional to clients.
